info.about: Senran Kagura Shinovi Versus is a 2013 action video game developed by Tamsoft, and the second main title in the Senran Kagura series as the sequel to Senran Kagura Burst. The game revolves around four female ninja groups from dueling shinobi schools.
info.trivia: XSEED's 2014 release shipped a limited edition with a soundtrack and a shinobi-themed bra.
info.why: A modest print run; the PC port covers players, so the disc trades on being the first Western entry.
